app.name: Atlas

onboarding.axisStudy: Study. Read about a species and it gets a frame.

onboarding.noAccount: No account needed. Everything stays on this device until you want to see it elsewhere.
onboarding.promisesBody: One from us, one from you.
onboarding.promisesOursText: No account, no leaderboard. Your data stays on this device until you want to see it elsewhere. Only the district is stored; exact places never leave your phone.
onboarding.promisesYoursText: Outdoors we are guests. We look, we marvel, we leave everything as we found it. No photo is worth crowding an animal or taking a plant. Walk slowly and you see more.
